_doc: Kesh's surfaces (docs/kb/art/creatures/vowbound/kesh.md). Slots are the glTF material names; write_materials.py writes assets/creatures/kesh/materials/<slot>.tres on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader. She is bound light (color_script.md rule 2): every emissive slot is glimmer_bound #4FB3B0 with no pulse (steady), and the vertex emission mask sets each part's share. The third pass gives her a value structure: a pale woman of water, in a dark robe set with pale stone mouths. water is her skin (the column, her arms and hands, her face, the runnels): standing seawater, pale and clear (the pale_rim water's deep #5E8C90 toward salt_glass, deeper toward the column's foot; vertex colour), wet and glassy (clearcoat, a low roughness, a fresnel rim so it reads as water and not glass or plastic), with her own faint light everywhere (mask 0.09) and the most on her face (0.2). robe is her garment, the bodice and the four panels: a deep sea-dark silk (abyss_navy toward indigo_dye), satin, matte beside her skin, a soft sheen at the edges so it holds its shape against a dark sea; the stole is the same slot in a third value, storm_slate toward cold_blue_stone, its edges pale. inner is the heart's pool on the bodice (the triangles whose pool passes 0.3), shaded as the robe is so the seam never shows. hair is her hair, many locks of dark falling water and the scalp under them, less glassy than her skin so it never reads as a helmet; its ends break foam_white (no light). mouths is the Choir's stone, the singers' weathered Lit Age white ceramic (pale_rim.md): a warm pale stone (lit_ceramic toward coral_stone_weathered and bone) on the carved mouths' plaques, the girdle and the neckline's cord, matte, with glimmer_bound inside each mouth (mask 0.4). key is the Lamplighter's lamp-key, the keepsake: brass going to bronze_patina, an object, never lit (energy 0). Colours are palette.json swatches.
